title: Textured Henleys Replace Plain Basics
description: The video highlights Henley t-shirts as a 2026 menswear move: still simple like a basic tee, but upgraded through waffle texture, a placket neckline, and more intentional layering value.

title: Gurkha Trousers Push Tailoring Into Daily Wear
description: Gurkha trousers and pleated high-waist shapes are a clear 2026 signal from the video, giving men a sharper alternative to generic chinos while keeping office and mall outfits wearable.

title: Cropped Shirts Balance High-Rise Bottoms
description: The video description calls out cropped shirts and links gingham and seersucker examples. The practical trend rule is proportion: shorter shirt length works best with high-waist trousers and bootcut denim.

title: Seersucker And Cotton-Linen Shirts Become Heat-Safe Smart Casual
description: Cotton-linen stripes and seersucker shirts in the video map directly into the app's climate rules: breathable texture, relaxed fit, and smart-casual polish for warm Indian weather.

title: Loafers And Vintage Belts Finish The Capsule
description: Loafers, square sunglasses, and vintage-buckle belts complete the 2026 styling direction from the video: clean accessories that lift simple shirts and trousers without depending on loud branding.
